subject: Phase 100110: Dense and Lexical Index Pipelines
verdict_justification: The developer delivered all core Phase 100110 capabilities: the clio-index crate with sidecar HTTP client, transactional outbox worker, rebuild hooks, and dual-backend vector/lexical search with extensive test coverage meeting all gates (98.85% functions, 98.50% lines aggregate, 0 files below 90%). The adversarial review identified two important functional/operational edge-case issues (zero-limit search returns 1 hit on IndexStore, and single-IP DNS resolution in HTTP connect failing on dual-stack localhost) and four minor issues (module headers on 7 test files, dead widening loop, eager rebuild page buffering, and missing Content-Length parsing). Remediation r1 (OpenCode CLI / Deepseek V4.1 Flash High) resolved all six findings: F-01 limit-0 guards on both backends, F-02 multi-address connect, F-03 module headers on all 7 files, F-04 dead lexical widening loop removed, F-05 lazy paged rebuild sweeps, F-06 Content-Length early stop. Re-verified: make check exit 0 (409 passed, 0 failed; fmt/clippy clean); make coverage exit 0 (98.50% lines / 98.78% functions; every one of 94 reported files >=90% on both).

findings.title: IndexStore search primitives return 1 hit when limit is 0
findings.recommendation: Add an early guard checking `if limit == 0 { return Ok(Vec::new()); }` at the start of `dense_search` and `lexical_search` on both SqliteStore and PostgresStore.
findings.resolution: Added `if limit == 0 { return Ok(vec![]); }` to dense_search and lexical_search in SqliteStore (crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_index.rs) and PostgresStore (crates/clio-store/src/postgres_index.rs). Contract suite now asserts empty results for limit 0 on both legs and both backends (crates/clio-store/src/index_store_tests.rs), so the fix is covered by sqlite_index_contract and postgres_index_contract.

findings.title: HTTP client connects only to first resolved IP address, failing on dual-stack localhost
findings.recommendation: Iterate through all candidate addresses returned by `to_socket_addrs()` and try `TcpStream::connect_timeout` on each candidate until one succeeds or all fail.
findings.resolution: connect() now iterates every SocketAddr from to_socket_addrs() and tries TcpStream::connect_timeout on each until one succeeds (crates/clio-index/src/http.rs). A dual-stack `localhost` whose first candidate (::1) is refused now falls through to the next candidate.

findings.title: Missing AGENTS.md mandatory module header structure in 7 newly created Rust files
findings.recommendation: Add the required module header format (`//! # Responsibility`, `//! ## Owns`, `//! ## Does not own`, `//! ## Boundary`) to all newly created test and test-support modules.
findings.resolution: Added the full AGENTS.md header (# Responsibility / ## Owns / ## Does not own / ## Boundary / Keep this module focused) to all 7 files: embed_knob_tests.rs, embed_test_support.rs, embed_tests.rs, http_tests.rs, rebuild_tests.rs, worker_tests.rs, index_store_tests.rs.

findings.title: Dead widening loop and potential duplicate accumulation in SqliteStore::lexical_search
findings.recommendation: Remove the redundant loop or initialize `out` inside the loop body, relying on SQL-level filtering and limits.
findings.resolution: Removed the dead widening loop from SqliteStore::lexical_search; the leg now issues a single query with SQL-level domain/visibility filtering and LIMIT ?3 (crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_index.rs). The Postgres twin already re-initialises `out` per iteration, which is the finding's alternative form.

findings.title: Eager full-bank ID buffering in visible_pages during rebuild sweeps
findings.recommendation: Stream or paginate item IDs on demand rather than buffering all pages for the entire bank into memory upfront.
findings.resolution: Replaced visible_pages() — which built a Vec<Vec<String>> of every bank page upfront — with for_each_visible_page(), which fetches one REBUILD_PAGE at a time and invokes a callback; sweep_dense and sweep_lexical consume pages lazily (crates/clio-index/src/worker.rs).

findings.title: HTTP client reads until EOF without checking Content-Length header
findings.recommendation: Parse `Content-Length` from the HTTP response head and terminate reading once the exact byte count is received.
findings.resolution: read_response() now parses Content-Length (new content_length() helper) and returns once the declared head+body byte count has arrived, so a server that keeps the socket open no longer stalls the reader until timeout; chunked responses still read to EOF (crates/clio-index/src/http.rs).

issues.title: IndexStore search primitives return 1 hit when limit is 0
issues.why_it_matters: Callers requesting zero results (e.g. for existence checks or pagination probes) receive an unexpected match.
issues.impact: Violates expected query limit semantics for callers directly invoking IndexStore trait methods.
issues.proposed_fix: Add an early check `if limit == 0 { return Ok(Vec::new()); }` at the start of dense_search and lexical_search on both SqliteStore and PostgresStore.
issues.resolution: Added `if limit == 0 { return Ok(vec![]); }` to dense_search and lexical_search in SqliteStore (crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_index.rs) and PostgresStore (crates/clio-store/src/postgres_index.rs). Contract suite now asserts empty results for limit 0 on both legs and both backends (crates/clio-store/src/index_store_tests.rs), so the fix is covered by sqlite_index_contract and postgres_index_contract.

issues.title: HTTP client connects only to first resolved IP address, failing on dual-stack localhost
issues.why_it_matters: Connecting to http://localhost:<port> fails if localhost resolves to IPv6 ::1 first while the sidecar is bound only to IPv4 127.0.0.1.
issues.impact: Standard development and container setups where TEI listens on 127.0.0.1 fail to connect if host is specified as 'localhost'.
issues.proposed_fix: Iterate through the SocketAddr iterator from to_socket_addrs() and attempt connect_timeout on each until one succeeds.
issues.resolution: connect() now iterates every SocketAddr from to_socket_addrs() and tries TcpStream::connect_timeout on each until one succeeds (crates/clio-index/src/http.rs). A dual-stack `localhost` whose first candidate (::1) is refused now falls through to the next candidate.

issues.title: Missing AGENTS.md mandatory module header structure in 7 newly created Rust files
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md mandates the Responsibility/Owns/Boundary docblock header on every Rust file.
issues.impact: Non-compliance with repository file header standards.
issues.proposed_fix: Add the required module header format including //! # Responsibility, //! ## Owns, //! ## Does not own, and //! ## Boundary to all 7 files.
issues.resolution: Added the full AGENTS.md header (# Responsibility / ## Owns / ## Does not own / ## Boundary / Keep this module focused) to all 7 files: embed_knob_tests.rs, embed_test_support.rs, embed_tests.rs, http_tests.rs, rebuild_tests.rs, worker_tests.rs, index_store_tests.rs.

issues.title: Dead widening loop and potential duplicate accumulation in SqliteStore::lexical_search
issues.why_it_matters: The loop in sqlite_index.rs::lexical_search is dead code because SQL filtering handles limits directly. If ever reached, it would duplicate results.
issues.impact: Misleading code structure that mimics dense vector widening where it does not apply.
issues.proposed_fix: Remove the loop and query directly with limit as parameter.
issues.resolution: Removed the dead widening loop from SqliteStore::lexical_search; the leg now issues a single query with SQL-level domain/visibility filtering and LIMIT ?3 (crates/clio-store/src/sqlite_index.rs). The Postgres twin already re-initialises `out` per iteration, which is the finding's alternative form.

issues.title: Eager full-bank ID buffering in visible_pages during rebuild sweeps
issues.why_it_matters: Rebuilding indexes for a bank with tens of thousands of items buffers all item IDs in memory at once.
issues.impact: Unnecessary memory consumption during reindex operations on large banks.
issues.proposed_fix: Stream or paginate item IDs lazily during rebuild sweeps.
issues.resolution: Replaced visible_pages() — which built a Vec<Vec<String>> of every bank page upfront — with for_each_visible_page(), which fetches one REBUILD_PAGE at a time and invokes a callback; sweep_dense and sweep_lexical consume pages lazily (crates/clio-index/src/worker.rs).

issues.title: HTTP client reads until EOF without checking Content-Length header
issues.why_it_matters: If a sidecar server sends a full Content-Length response but delays socket shutdown, read_response blocks until the timeout.
issues.impact: Potential latency spikes if connected to HTTP/1.1 servers that don't immediately close sockets on Connection: close.
issues.proposed_fix: Parse Content-Length from response headers and terminate reading once expected bytes have been consumed.
issues.resolution: read_response() now parses Content-Length (new content_length() helper) and returns once the declared head+body byte count has arrived, so a server that keeps the socket open no longer stalls the reader until timeout; chunked responses still read to EOF (crates/clio-index/src/http.rs).
